verdict.rationale: Typesense documents built-in high availability with automatic Raft leader election in the open-source server (typesense-docs-41, typesense-docs-46). Typesense Cloud offers HA and dedicated clusters with no record limits (typesense-docs-22, typesense-docs-20), and self-hosters get Kubernetes and Docker Swarm deployment paths (typesense-docs-5, typesense-docs-18). However, the largest dataset evidenced is 32M documents (typesense-gh-1), and the in-memory design makes scale RAM-bound (typesense-comm-1); the founder also positions Elasticsearch as better suited for billions of documents (typesense-comm-13). Missing for 10: in-depth clustering/replication configuration docs, any sharding or horizontal partitioning path, evidence of deployments at hundreds of millions of documents, and independent hands-on HA corroboration.
